items.name: Royal Crystal Fountain
items.description: A sparkling tiered fountain crowned with glowing crystals and cool falling water.

items.name: Blooming Rose Topiary
items.description: An ornate ceramic planter with spiral roses in shades of pink, cream, and magenta.

items.name: Castle Crest Banners
items.description: Trio of gold, cobalt, and crimson silk banners bearing Princess Penelope's royal crest.

items.name: Gilded Fairy Streetlamp
items.description: A wrought iron curved lamppost that casts a warm, cozy amber glow at dusk.

items.name: Golden Peacock Statue
items.description: A hand-sculpted gold statue with feathered plumage to welcome visitors to the grounds.

items.name: Penelope's Flower Swing
items.description: A wooden garden canopy swing entwined with climbing wild roses and soft velvet cushions.

items.name: Velvet Crown Throne
items.description: A tufted ruby-red velvet throne with golden armrests and a carved royal crown headpiece.

items.name: Cozy Daybed Couch
items.description: A plush cream couch with embroidered gold pillows and a draped raspberry throw blanket.

items.name: Gilded Royal Chaise
items.description: An elegant scrolled chaise lounge lined with silk damask and cozy cushions.

items.name: Ornate Storybook Mirror
items.description: An oval mirror with filigree gold scrolls that shimmers with soft enchanted sparkles.

items.name: Princess Teatime Table
items.description: A hand-painted rose tablecloth topped with a porcelain teapot, cups, and berry tarts.

items.name: Grand Fairytale Bookshelf
items.description: A polished mahogany bookcase packed with phonics tales, poetry, and spellbooks.

items.name: Sparkling Crystal Chandelier
items.description: A hanging brass and crystal chandelier with glowing candle tapers and sparkling prisms.
